name: create_health_endpoint_node
prompts: Create an Express server in server.js. Add a GET /health endpoint that responds with JSON {"status": "ok"}. Have the server listen on port 8002. Do not include a package.json - express is already installed globally.

test_setup_files.test_health.py:
import subprocess, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error
srv = subprocess.Popen(['node', 'server.js'])
try:
    body = None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8002/health', timeout=1) as resp:
                assert resp.status == 200, f'expected 200, got {resp.status}'
                body = json.loads(resp.read())
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert body is not None, 'server never became reachable on :8002'
    assert body.get('status') == 'ok', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
